summary: Hermes parallelism layer — DORMANT (gated OFF by default as of v1.4, 2026-06-16). All entry points inside /z-plan, /z-implement-all, /z-plan-split are wrapped in 'if workflow.hermes_enabled'; default=false so none fire. To revive: set workflow.hermes_enabled=true in .z-harness/config.toml. scripts/hermes/ files are intentionally kept (not deleted) to prevent bit-rot — deferred cleanup. Concurrency/retry/timeout knobs moved from removed HERMES_* env vars to workflow.* file config (T017). When enabled: within-plan DAG concurrency via generate-workstreams.py (assign_ws_depths → parallel_group=level-{depth}); hermes-execute.py runs compute_ready_level → partition_level (greedy graph-coloring) → asyncio.gather bounded by asyncio.Semaphore(max_parallel_workstreams). Cross-plan: run_cross_plan(--slugs/--plan-set) calls build_plan_conflict_graph, acquire_plan_locks (sorted ascending slug, deadlock-free INV-6), schedule_batches. Single asyncio.Lock serializes merges. Default cap=1 (INV-5). Non-file shared state (DBs, ports) NOT protected — use serialize_all escape hatch.

entry_points.summary: Async coroutine: creates worktree, spawns pi session, polls status, merges. Acquires merge_lock (asyncio.Lock) around merge_workstream call. Semaphore held for full lifetime.
Async: reads workstreams.json for one slug, runs compute_ready_level → partition_level → asyncio.gather loop. Accepts merge_lock from run_cross_plan for cross-plan merge serialization.

Async: multi-slug entry point. Calls build_plan_conflict_graph, acquire_plan_locks, schedule_batches. Creates single in-process asyncio.Lock threaded to all run_single_plan calls. Bounded by asyncio.Semaphore(max_parallel_plans).

Greedy graph-coloring: partitions a ready level into sub-batches where no two workstreams in the same sub-batch share a HIGH-severity file_conflicts edge (when serialize_high_severity=True). scope_unknown or serialize_all → singleton sub-batches.
Returns workstreams whose depends_on are all in terminal_status (done). depends_on is the sole scheduling gate (INV-2).
Builds plan-level conflict graph: two plans conflict iff file-scope path-sets intersect OR either is scope_unknown/low-confidence/missing. Fail-safe: unknown scope always conflicts.
Acquires plan-claim locks in SORTED ascending slug order (INV-6: deadlock-free). Releases all on any failure. Returns held locks.
Greedy batch coloring over the plan conflict graph: disjoint plans grouped in same batch, conflicting plans serialized. Returns ordered list of batches.
Computes longest-path depth for each workstream over the depends_on DAG. Sets parallel_group='level-{depth}'. Same-depth workstreams are mutually independent by construction.

Parses **Files:** lines from each task block in TASKS.md to derive per-workstream file scope. If any task lacks a parseable **Files:** line, scope_unknown=True → conservative full serialization (INV-4).
Synchronous git merge of hermes/<slug>/<ws_id> into base. Called under the in-process asyncio.Lock — never runs concurrently across workstreams or plans.

invariants: INV-1: Concurrent workstreams write to isolated git worktrees; the working tree is never shared.
INV-2: depends_on is the sole scheduling gate — a workstream starts only when all its depends_on IDs reach 'done'. parallel_group is a derived label, NOT a scheduling mechanism.
INV-3: merge_order is authoritative for merge sequence — merges always proceed in declared order, never in completion order.
INV-4: scope_unknown=True or serialize_all=True forces fully-sequential execution (singleton sub-batches). Silent blind parallelism is forbidden when conflict data is absent or low-confidence.
INV-5: max_parallel_workstreams=1 (default) reproduces pre-v1.3 sequential behavior exactly. cap=1 ≡ legacy sequential.
INV-6: Plan-claim locks are always acquired in sorted ascending slug order — prevents AB/BA deadlocks across concurrent super-orchestrators.
INV-7: parallel_group and scope_unknown are additive fields (forward-compatible). Pre-v1.3 manifests omitting scope_unknown default to false; null parallel_group treated as scope_unknown (fail-safe).
gotchas: DORMANT BY DEFAULT (v1.4): workflow.hermes_enabled defaults to false. All workstream-generation, handoff, and cross-plan dispatch inside commands are no-ops unless hermes_enabled=true is set in .z-harness/config.toml.

HERMES_* env vars are GONE (T017): HERMES_MAX_PARALLEL, HERMES_MAX_PARALLEL_PLANS, HERMES_SERIALIZE_ALL, HERMES_SERIALIZE_HIGH_SEVERITY, HERMES_WORKSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MINUTES, HERMES_MAX_RETRIES are all removed. Setting them has no effect. Use workflow.* file knobs.
Semaphore is held for the FULL run_workstream lifetime (spawn → monitor → merge), not just at spawn time. This bounds live sessions, not spawn rate (audit M1).
poll_session runs via asyncio.to_thread so one stalled poll cannot starve sibling coroutines.
GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 is set for the run and restored after — prevents concurrent git gc contention against the shared object store.

Non-file shared state (databases, ports, remote sandboxes, in-memory caches) is NOT protected by the file-conflict layer. Use workflow.serialize_all=true in .z-harness/config.toml to force fully-sequential execution when workstreams share such resources.
scope_unknown is derived from parse_task_files: if ANY task block in TASKS.md lacks a parseable **Files:** line, the entire plan is treated as scope_unknown=True.
The merge_lock is a single in-process asyncio.Lock — it serializes merges across all workstreams AND all plans within one run_cross_plan call. Two plans never merge concurrently.

cap=1 is the safe default — parallelism is opt-in via workflow.max_parallel_workstreams / workflow.max_parallel_plans. Do not raise caps in production without first verifying workstreams have no non-file shared-state dependencies.
scripts/hermes/ files are kept (not deleted) to prevent bit-rot while dormant. A future cleanup task will remove them once the gating strategy is confirmed stable.

config_keys.note: HERMES_* env vars are REMOVED (v1.4, T017). All Hermes knobs are now file-based, read by scripts/hermes/config.py ConcurrencyConfig from .z-harness/config.toml under the [workflow] section.

concurrency.description: Master gate. Must be true for any Hermes machinery to fire. Default false = dormant (all workstream/handoff/cross-plan calls are no-ops).
Max workstreams running concurrently within a single plan. Default 1 = legacy sequential (INV-5). Semaphore held for full workstream lifetime.
Max plans running concurrently in a cross-plan run. Default 1.
Force fully-sequential execution regardless of conflict analysis. Use when workstreams share non-file state (DBs, ports). Equivalent to scope_unknown=True for scheduling.
When true, HIGH-severity file_conflicts edges force serialization within a level even when max_parallel_workstreams > 1.
Max re-spawns on workstream crash before marking halted.

runbook.revive_hermes: Set workflow.hermes_enabled = true in .z-harness/config.toml. Without this, all Hermes machinery is dormant.
runbook.within_plan_parallel: Set workflow.max_parallel_workstreams = N in .z-harness/config.toml, then: python3 scripts/hermes-execute.py --slug <slug>
runbook.cross_plan_slugs: Set workflow.max_parallel_plans = N in .z-harness/config.toml, then: python3 scripts/hermes-execute.py --slugs a,b,c
runbook.cross_plan_file: Set workflow.max_parallel_plans = N in .z-harness/config.toml, then: python3 scripts/hermes-execute.py --plan-set plans.txt
runbook.serialize_all: Set workflow.serialize_all = true in .z-harness/config.toml, then: python3 scripts/hermes-execute.py --slug <slug>
runbook.non_file_shared_state_note: If workstreams share databases, ports, remote sandboxes, or other process-level resources, set workflow.serialize_all = true in .z-harness/config.toml. The file_conflicts layer does not model these dependencies.
runbook.deferred_cleanup_note: scripts/hermes/ and scripts/hermes-execute.py are kept dormant (not deleted). Deletion is a separate future task.
